title: Chicago drill
style: English, Chicago drill, male rapper, dark piano, sliding 808 bass, hi-hat rolls, menacing, 140 bpm
lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse]
Came up from the bottom on the South Side block,
Every winter cold but I never stopped,
Mama told me keep my head up, keep it clean,
Now I'm turning all my pain into a dream machine.

[Chorus]
Rise up, rise up from the concrete ground,
Every block I walk, they gon' hear my sound,
Hands up high, we ain't going down,
From the Chi to the world, we gon' take the crown.

[Verse]
Hundred bars written on a cracked phone screen,
Late night studio, the hunger in between,
They ain't never think we'd make it out the cold,
Now my story's on the radio, the truth be told.

[Chorus]
Rise up, rise up from the concrete ground,
Every block I walk, they gon' hear my sound,
Hands up high, we ain't going down,
From the Chi to the world, we gon' take the crown.

[Outro]
